messages:
Maria Chen: quick follow-up from the late-night postmortem — consolidating the rollout/canary items into one short sweep. main asks: auto-rollback rules, smaller blast radius defaults, and an ownership handoff for recurrent patterns.

Jonah Patel: ack. can we pair on the auto-rollback heuristics? saw the surge in retries when flagged traffic spiked. thinking of error_rate + latency combo. :thinking_face: 

Tara O'Neill: +1. also we should restrict flag scope by region and customer tier by default. a global wide-open flag is what bit us.

Sam (SRE): adding one data point — aggregated telemetry shows a repeating pattern across 3 incidents: gradual latency climb -> throttled CPU -> request queue overflow. makes a case for a two-stage rollback.

Maria Chen: agree. proposal sketch: stage 1 = soft rollback (reduce % to 0 over 5m) when latency increase > 20% AND p95 > 800ms; stage 2 = hard rollback if error_rate > 2% sustained for 3m. stage 1 gives graceful degradation and prefix-cache retention.

Jonah Patel: that sounds reasonable. do we have a sample flag config we can test in staging? I can mock a gate and run traffic replay.

Tara O'Neill: here's a simple example for the flag controller (drop in to the rollout service):
```
name: gate_new_routing
default: false
scopes:
  - region: us-*
  - customer_tier: beta
max_percent: 10
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  soft_thresholds:
    latency_p95_pct_increase: 20
    window_minutes: 5
  hard_thresholds:
    error_rate_pct: 2
    window_minutes: 3
monitoring_sources: [latency, error_rate, cpu_util]
```

Maria Chen: perfect. can we add a quota cap (max_users) to force a low blast radius by default? default to 200 for early rollouts.

Sam (SRE): +1 on quota cap. also suggest a circuit-breaker for request queue length > 5000 that triggers immediate throttling and alert.

Jonah Patel: action: I'll stand up a canary in staging with that config and run the last incident replay. ETA EOD tomorrow. assigning to @Jonah.

Tara O'Neill: action: I'll update the rollout playbook with the soft/hard thresholds and include instructions for scope scoping and max_users. ETA 48h. assigning to @Tara.

Maria Chen: action: I'll draft the automation for two-stage rollback in the control plane and wire the telemetry hooks. ETA 1 week. assigning to @Maria.

Sam (SRE): action: I'll add the circuit-breaker rule to the SRE runbook and create the alert runbook snippet. ETA 72h. assigning to @Sam.

deploy-bot: note: scheduled test canary deployment created in staging for job:j-replay-2026-03-24-18. see https://deploys.internal/replay/12345.

Jonah Patel: quick question — should the soft rollback maintain half of KV cache so warm prefixes still help? Maria, is that feasible?

Maria Chen: yes — soft rollback will avoid full restart; runtime will mark new variant at reduced weight and keep KV caches alive for warm tokens. I'll add a paragraph in the PR about cache behavior.

Tara O'Neill: minor ops note: add a required pre-merge checklist item for any rollout that enables new routing: (1) target scope narrower than global, (2) max_percent <= 10, (3) include auto_rollback config, (4) telemetry hook verified.

Jonah Patel: got it. I'll use the checklist when I push the staging canary.

Maria Chen: recurring-patterns item: Sam, can you surface the 3 incidents telemetry into one small digest? we want to see exact windows where p95 started trending up. that will help tune thresholds.

Sam (SRE): will do. I'll post a short digest in #incidents and attach the graphs. ETA tomorrow morning.

Tara O'Neill: timeline recap in thread: Jonah (staging test) — EOD tomorrow; Tara (playbook + checklist) — 48h; Maria (automation PR) — 1 week; Sam (digests + alerts) — 72h.

Maria Chen: thanks everyone. if the staging replay shows false positives, we iterate on thresholds. will run a quick sync Friday 10:30 to close the loop. :white_check_mark:

Sam (SRE): noted. I'll invite the oncall rotation for the sync.

deploy-bot: reminder: canary run completed in staging without errors at 2026-03-24T18:15:23Z (job:j-replay-2026-03-24-18). logs: https://deploys.internal/replay/12345/logs

Jonah Patel: saw logs, running analysis now. will post failures/observations in this thread.

Maria Chen: closing note: once PRs are merged, we should enable the pre-merge checklist enforcement in CI for rollout manifests. low-friction but enforced defaults are the point.

Tara O'Neill: :thumbsup: good work team.
